title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Credicard Hall, São Paulo | 2011
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Credicard Hall in São Paulo, Brazil, on 12 November 2011.

It was the 34th show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between June and November 2011, and the first of two consecutive nights in São Paulo.

Starr returned to the Credicard Hall on 29 October 2013.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
